### 4. Decide whether to slice

Apply [the slice criteria](skill://orchestrate-factory/references/product-documentation-process--when-a-feature-needs-slices.md). A single-slice feature has no system design; its TDD follows the PRD directly. For a multi-slice feature, the system design decides the slice count, names each slice, and orders independently testable handoffs.
